title: Maximum Number of Items From Sale I
summary: Items have a divisibility factor and a price; unlimited copies may be purchased within budget. Buying at least one copy of type i grants one free copy of every different type j whose factor is divisible by i's factor. Further purchases of i do not repeat these grants, but different purchased types can independently grant copies of the same j. Maximize purchased plus free copies. Free copies do not trigger further grants.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
